pages.library: Automated Driving Toolbox Interface for Eclipse SUMO Traffic Simulator

fm.title: Sumo interface
fm.description: Eclipse SUMO traffic simulator co-simulation blocks for closed-loop testing with microscopic traffic (5 blocks)

rows.intent: Control a specific traffic participant (vehicle, pedestrian, or cyclist) in the SUMO simulation — use to override SUMO-managed actor behavior with Simulink-computed trajectories for ego or controlled vehicles
Establish and manage the TraCI connection to a running SUMO traffic simulation — use as the central communication hub that synchronizes simulation time steps between Simulink and SUMO

Read traffic state data (vehicle positions, speeds, traffic light phases) from the SUMO simulation — use to import the current traffic environment state into Simulink for perception or planning algorithms
Launch and manage a SUMO traffic simulation server instance — use to start SUMO with a specified network and route configuration, controlling its lifecycle from within Simulink
Send commands and data to the SUMO simulation (e.g., set traffic light phases, add vehicles) — use to modify the traffic environment dynamically based on Simulink controller decisions
